data.raw_text:
[9PM] #Ketu #TrafficUpdate 

Free flow of traffic in and out of the axis, indicating a significant improvement in traffic conditions.
Fast-moving traffic from Ojota towards Interchange.
Smooth traffic conditions on the Interchange ascending overhead bridge, down to 7Up.
Good traffic flow on the stretch from Interchange/Iyana School through Tipper Garage, Demurin Junction, and Ile-Ile.
Improved traffic conditions on the return journey from Iyana School, inward to Ile-Ile, down to Ikosi Junction, with both service lanes and main carriageways experiencing better movement.
Manageable traffic at Ikosi Junction, connecting Fruits Market, Interchange, and Ojota proper, with both service lanes and main carriageways operating relatively smoothly.
Better movement from Fruits Market inward Toll Gate.

#FollowLASTMA
